topic_title: Banking and RBI Policies in Indian Economy

intro_payload.title: 🏦 Banking and RBI Policies
intro_payload.subtitle: Master the Heart of Indian Economy
learning_outcomes: Structure of Indian Banking System - Commercial Banks, RRBs, Co-operative Banks
Reserve Bank of India - Functions, Monetary Policy Tools
Banking Reforms - Nationalization, LPG Era, NPAs
Key Policy Instruments - CRR, SLR, Repo Rate, Reverse Repo
Financial Inclusion & Digital Banking - Jan Dhan, UPI, NEFT/RTGS
⭐ BPSC TRE: Bihar-specific banking development & SHG models

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Raju, tumhare Papa apni salary kahan rakhte hain?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bank mein Sir! State Bank of India mein unka account hai.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Perfect! Aur agar tumhe cycle khareedni hai par paisa kam pad raha hai, to kya kar sakte ho?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Udhaar maang sakte hain... ya Papa se loan le sakte hain... par bank se bhi to loan milta hai na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bank deposits accept karke savers ka paisa manage karta hai aur borrowers ko loans/credit deta hai. Saath hi payments, remittances, liquidity aur risk-management services bhi hoti hain; deposit ko 'safe' kehna regulated protection ke context mein samjho, unlimited guarantee nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab bank ek middleman hai? Jo paisa rakhta bhi hai aur deta bhi hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bilkul sahi! Bank 'financial intermediary' hai - jo savers (jinhone paisa bachaya) aur borrowers (jinhe paisa chahiye) ke beech connection banata hai. Lekin yeh sara system kaun control karta hai? Kaun decide karta hai ki banks kaise kaam karein?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Hmmm... shayad government?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) India ka central bank hai, 1 April 1935 ko establish hua aur 1949 mein nationalise hua. Ye monetary policy, banknote issue (₹1 note ko chhodkar), banking/financial regulation, foreign exchange aur payment-system oversight jaise functions karta hai. RBI 'all banks ka owner/boss' nahi; regulator aur central-bank authority hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To ₹1 note ka issuer alag hai, par RBI central bank ke roop mein baaki banknotes aur monetary system ko manage karta hai? Current denominations ko issue-status ke saath dekhna hoga.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: ₹1 banknote Government of India/Finance Ministry issue karti hai; baaki banknotes RBI issue karta hai under RBI Act. Note printing aur issuing ko same phrase na samjho, aur withdrawn denomination (jaise ₹2, ₹5, ₹2000) ko current circulation list se mix na karo. RBI banks ka banker bhi hai—scheduled banks RBI ke paas balances rakhte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Waah! Banks ka bhi bank hai RBI!

quiz_payload.question: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ki establishment kab hui thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: RBI ki establishment 1 April 1935 ko hui thi, British India ke time mein. Independence ke baad 1949 mein isko nationalize kar diya gaya. Yeh SSC aur Railway exams ka favorite question hai!

quiz_payload.question: Kaun sa note RBI issue NAHI karta?
quiz_payload.explanation: ₹1 banknote Government of India/Finance Ministry issue karti hai; RBI baaki banknotes issue karta hai under law. Note denominations in circulation/withdrawal ko current RBI notification ke saath check karo—question ka core distinction ₹1 issuer hai.

quiz_payload.question: Bank ka primary function kya hai?

options.text: Deposits accept karna aur Loans dena dono

quiz_payload.explanation: Bank ka primary function hai deposits accept karna (savers se) aur loans dena (borrowers ko). Yeh 'financial intermediation' kehlata hai. Share trading secondary activity hai, primary nahi!

milestone_payload.title: 🎯 Banking Basics Cleared!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Shabash! Banking ki basics clear! Ab Indian Banking Structure detail mein samjhenge!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: India mein major banking categories Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks aur Co-operative Banks hain; Small Finance Banks aur Payments Banks bhi specialised categories hain. Inka ownership, licence, target customer aur permitted activities alag hoti hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir Commercial Banks to suna hai... par RRBs aur Co-operative Banks kya hote hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Pehle Commercial Banks samjhte hain. Yeh do types ke hote hain - Public Sector Banks (government ke hain, jaise SBI, PNB) aur Private Sector Banks (private companies ke hain, jaise HDFC, ICICI). Public Sector Banks mein government ka majority ownership hota hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab SBI sarkar ka bank hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Public Sector Banks mein government ka majority ownership/control hota hai; exact legal/ownership status ko current list ke saath verify karo. 1969 mein 14 aur 1980 mein 6 major private banks nationalise hue—objective branch expansion, priority-sector credit aur development banking tha.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Nationalization matlab Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Nationalisation ka historical rationale ye tha ki banking credit ko agriculture, small industry, exports aur weaker sections tak expand kiya jaye; 'private banks sirf ameer/urban logon ko loan dete the' ek policy criticism/rationale tha, universal description nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa... social welfare ke liye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Private-sector banks private shareholders/companies ke control mein hote hain; HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank aur Axis Bank examples hain. 1990s reforms ke baad new private-bank licensing badhi. Interest rate, service quality aur technology ko PSB/private label se automatically higher/lower conclude nahi karna—product, risk aur market conditions compare karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir to dono mein kya better hai - Public ya Private?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: PSBs ko priority-sector and inclusion obligations ka framework hota hai; private banks bhi RBI rules ke under priority-sector lending karte hain. Dono RBI-regulated hain, aur customer choice service, price, access aur risk ke basis par evaluate hoti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan Sir, gaon ke banks batao!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: RRBs 1975 se rural/semi-urban credit ke liye aaye. Traditional ownership pattern Central Government 50%, State Government 15% aur sponsor bank 35% hai; amalgamation ke baad individual RRB ke name/sponsor ko current RBI/NABARD notification se check karo. Bihar mein 1 May 2025 se unified **Bihar Gramin Bank** PNB-sponsored RRB hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir sponsor bank kaun hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Sponsor bank RRB ko banking, technology aur managerial support deta hai; current Bihar example mein PNB sponsor hai. RRB ka target rural households, farmers, artisans aur small entrepreneurs hai—cooperative banks ka ownership/governance model alag hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab gaon mein teen types - RRBs, Co-operative Banks, aur commercial banks ki branches!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Rural cooperative credit ka common three-tier structure PACS (village), District Central Cooperative Banks (district) aur State Cooperative Banks (state) hai. Urban Cooperative Banks alag category hain; members' ownership/control principle ko management quality ya guaranteed safety ka synonym na samjho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir yeh to democratic banking hai - members khud decide karte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Cooperative banks/PACS mein governance, dual regulation, capital aur management challenges ho sakte hain. RBI aur other authorities ke regulatory roles category-wise alag hain; PMC Bank crisis ko har cooperative bank par generalise nahi karna chahiye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan Sir, news mein tha! To banking structure samajh aa raha hai - Commercial, RRBs, Co-operative!

quiz_payload.question: India mein major bank nationalization kab hua tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: 1969 mein Indira Gandhi ne 14 major private banks ko nationalize kiya, aur 1980 mein 6 aur banks ko. Total 20 banks nationalize hue. Yeh BPSC aur SSC ka high-frequency question hai!

quiz_payload.question: Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) kab establish hue the?
quiz_payload.explanation: RRBs 1975 mein establish hue the rural aur semi-urban areas mein banking services dene ke liye. Pehla RRB tha Prathama Bank (Uttar Pradesh mein). Railway exams mein ye direct puchha jaata hai!

quiz_payload.question: RRBs mein Central Government ka ownership kitna hota hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: RRBs mein ownership pattern: Central Govt - 50%, State Govt - 15%, Sponsor Bank - 35%. Yeh exact ratio SSC aur UPSC Prelims mein puchha jaata hai!

milestone_payload.title: 🏆 Banking Structure Mastered!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Excellent! Ab RBI ke functions aur powers detail mein samjhenge!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: RBI ke main functions yaad rakho - 'MISBRIC' acronym se! M=Monetary Authority (monetary policy banata hai), I=Issuer of Currency (notes issue karta hai), S=Supervisor of Banks, B=Banker to Government, R=Regulator of financial system, I=Manager of Foreign Exchange, C=Controller of Credit.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: MISBRIC! Ye to exam mein help karega Sir! Par inka detail batao na?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Monetary policy ke through RBI policy rates, liquidity aur expectations ko influence karta hai. Inflation pressure par tightening ho sakti hai; weak growth par easing consider ki ja sakti hai, lekin RBI ka statutory mandate price stability with growth objective ko recognise karta hai—single automatic rate rule nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa... inflation control karne ke liye RBI interest rates badhata hai!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, kya Repo Rate ka faisla akele RBI Governor apne man se lete hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Pehle aisa hota tha, par 2016 ke baad nahi! Ab yeh faisla [[Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) | 6 sadasyon wali committee jo desh ke policy interest rates decide karti hai]] karti hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Is committee mein kaun-kaun log hote hain Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: MPC mein 6 members hote hain: 3 RBI side se aur 3 Central Government nominees. Governor chairperson hote hain aur tie par casting vote hota hai. Flexible inflation-targeting framework mein headline CPI target 4% with ±2 percentage-point tolerance band hai; target ka matlab har month 4% fix karna nahi.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Important monetary-policy/liquidity tools mein repo, standing deposit facility (SDF), reverse repo, CRR, SLR aur MSF shamil hain. Inka operational role corridor, liquidity conditions aur RBI framework ke saath samjho; textbook list ko current policy toolkit ka complete fixed list na samjho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Repo Rate kya hota hai Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Repo rate par RBI eligible collateral ke against banks ko liquidity deta hai. Repo badhne se short-term funding costly ho sakti hai aur demand/inflation pressure par effect aa sakta hai, lekin pass-through, credit demand aur transmission time lag ke saath aate hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab Repo Rate badha = loans expensive = kam log loan lenge = inflation control!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Reverse repo mein RBI banks se liquidity absorb karta hai against securities; SDF mein eligible banks RBI ke paas funds park kar sakte hain bina collateral ke. Operational absorption ke liye SDF ka role important hai; reverse repo ko simply 'hamesha main tool' na samjho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Toh Repo mein RBI deta hai banks ko, aur Reverse Repo mein banks dete hain RBI ko!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Repo RBI ki lending facility; reverse repo/SDF liquidity absorption tools. Exact rate corridor aur use current RBI policy statement ke saath check karna hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir CRR aur SLR kya hain?

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir, Reverse Repo mein jab bank RBI ke paas paisa jama karte hain, toh kya RBI unhe koi security girvi deta hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 2022 mein RBI ne SDF introduce kiya: eligible banks surplus liquidity RBI ke paas park kar sakte hain bina collateral. Reverse repo collateral-based absorption facility hai; dono ko rate aur operational role ke context mein alag samjho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab bina security ke paisa jama? Phir Reverse Repo ka kya hua?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: SDF policy corridor ka floor aur MSF upper-side facility ke roop mein use hota hai; inke spread ko 'hamesha exactly 0.25%' na ratna, kyunki rates/operational settings policy decisions ke saath change ho sakte hain.

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CRR (Cash Reserve Ratio) - har bank ko apne total deposits ka ek percentage RBI ke paas cash ke roop mein rakhna hota hai. Agar CRR 4% hai aur kisi bank ke paas ₹100 crore deposits hain, to ₹4 crore RBI ke paas cash rakhna mandatory hai. Is paisy par bank ko koi interest nahi milta!

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab bank apna sara paisa loan nahi de sakta?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: CRR mein prescribed cash RBI ke paas maintain hota hai; SLR mein bank liquid assets—government securities, gold ya other approved securities—apne paas maintain karta hai. CRR balance par interest nahi milta; SLR securities par return mil sakta hai. Percentages current RBI notification ke saath check karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Waah! To RBI in tools se control karta hai kitna paisa market mein ja sakta hai!

quiz_payload.question: Repo Rate kya hai?

options.text: Woh rate jis par banks customers ko loan dete hain
Woh rate jis par RBI banks ko loan deta hai
Woh rate jis par banks RBI se paisa lete hain
B aur C dono sahi hain

quiz_payload.explanation: Repo Rate woh rate hai jis par RBI commercial banks ko short-term loan deta hai (usually overnight). Option B aur C dono technically sahi hain. UPSC aur BPSC mein exact wording pe dhyan dena zaroori hai!

quiz_payload.question: CRR (Cash Reserve Ratio) ke under banks ko RBI ke paas rakhe paisy par kya milta hai?

options.text: Reverse Repo Rate ke barabar interest

quiz_payload.explanation: CRR ke under banks ko RBI ke paas rakhe cash par KUCH BHI INTEREST NAHI MILTA! Yeh idle money hai. SLR mein government securities hote hain jinpe interest milta hai. Yeh SSC ka favorite confusion trap hai!

quiz_payload.question: SLR (Statutory Liquidity Ratio) ke under banks ko invest karna hota hai:

options.text: Government securities, gold, aur approved securities mein

quiz_payload.explanation: SLR ke liye bank ko prescribed liquid assets maintain karne hote hain—government securities/T-bills, gold aur eligible approved securities. Ye ordinary share-market ya real-estate investment ka rule nahi.

milestone_payload.title: 💪 RBI Functions Conquered!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Outstanding! Policy tools clear! Ab banking reforms aur NPAs dekhte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1991 mein India ne economic liberalization shuru ki - LPG reforms (Liberalization, Privatization, Globalization). Banking sector mein bhi major reforms aaye. Narasimha Rao Committee (1991) ne recommend kiya ki private banks ko license diya jaye, aur PSBs ko zyada autonomy di jaye.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: 1991 se pehle private banks nahi the kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 1969-1980 ke nationalization ke baad new private banks ko license nahi diya ja raha tha. 1991 ke baad HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank jaise new generation private banks aaye. 1993 mein pehli baar licenses diye gaye. Yeh 'Second Generation Reforms' kehlate hain banking mein.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir par PSBs mein abhi problem kya hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NPA tab classify hota hai jab loan account mein interest/principal ki instalment prescribed period tak overdue rahe; standard term-loan norm aam taur par 90 days overdue hai, subject to RBI category/rules. Sirf ek late instalment ko immediately NPA na samjho.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab bank ne loan diya, par wapas nahi aa raha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 2017–18 ka high PSB NPA ratio historical figure hai, current ratio nahi. NPA stress borrower, sector, provisioning, recovery aur bank type ke hisaab se badalta hai. IBC 2016 aur recovery mechanisms resolution improve karne ke liye laaye gaye, automatic success guarantee nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: To ab recovery kaise ho rahi hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Recovery tools mein SARFAESI, DRTs aur IBC/NCLT process shamil hain. SARFAESI secured assets par prescribed procedure ke tahat enforcement allow karta hai; borrower remedies aur exclusions bhi hain. NARCL stressed assets resolution ke liye asset-reconstruction structure hai, ordinary 'bad loans ki guarantee' nahi.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Bad Bank matlab Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Bad-bank model stressed assets ko separate karke bank balance sheet/management capacity improve karne ka attempt hai; recovery price, collateral, legal process aur governance par depend karti hai. Is model ko automatically internationally successful na declare karo—pros and cons evaluate karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa... banks ka burden kam karne ke liye!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Recent years mein government ne PSBs ko merge kiya hai efficiency badhane ke liye. 2019-20 mein 10 PSBs ko merge karke 4 bana diya - Punjab National Bank, Canara Bank, Union Bank of India, aur Indian Bank mein chhote banks merge hue. Idea hai ki bade banks zyada strong aur globally competitive honge.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Par Sir chhote banks ka kya faida tha?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 2019–20 mergers ke baad 12 PSBs rahe, aur ye count current policy changes ke saath verify karna chahiye. Mergers se scale/technology/capital benefits possible hain, lekin integration cost, branch access, staff culture aur local service risks bhi ho sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab banking sector streamline ho raha hai!

quiz_payload.question: Koi loan technically NPA kab declare hota hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: 90 DIN tak agar principal ya interest payment nahi aata, to loan NPA (Non-Performing Asset) declare ho jata hai. Yeh RBI ka standard guideline hai. Earlier ye 180 din tha, 2004 mein 90 din kar diya gaya. UPSC aur SSC ka favorite question!

quiz_payload.question: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) kab pass hua tha?
quiz_payload.explanation: IBC 2016 mein pass hua aur 2016 se hi implement hai. Yeh NPA resolution ko fast-track karne ke liye laya gaya tha. NCLT (National Company Law Tribunal) is code ke under operate karti hai. Railway aur SSC mein year puchha jaata hai!

quiz_payload.question: Recent mergers ke baad India mein kitne Public Sector Banks hain (2023 tak)?
quiz_payload.explanation: 2019-2020 ke mergers ke baad India mein 12 PUBLIC SECTOR BANKS hain (including SBI aur iske associates). Earlier 27 PSBs the. Yeh current affairs ka important part hai - BPSC aur UPSC dono mein puchha jaata hai!

milestone_payload.title: 🚀 Banking Reforms Mastered!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Fantastic! Ab financial inclusion aur digital banking ka journey!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Financial inclusion ka matlab affordable, usable banking/payments/credit/insurance services ko excluded groups tak pahunchana hai—sirf account kholna nahi. PMJDY 2014 mein launch hua aur accounts, DBT, RuPay, overdraft/insurance benefits scheme conditions ke subject provide karta hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Jan Dhan Yojana mein kya special hai Sir?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: PMJDY zero-balance account possibility, RuPay card, eligible overdraft aur accident-insurance cover provide karta hai; benefit limits/account eligibility time ke saath revise ho sakti hain. Crore-level accounts hain, par exact current count official PMJDY dashboard se quote karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Wow! To gareeb log bhi banking facility use kar sakte hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Jan Dhan ka impact: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) mein help - government subsidies seedha bank account mein jaati hain (LPG subsidy, MGNREGA wages), financial literacy badhti hai, aur women empowerment (majority accounts women ke hain). ⭐ BPSC TRE: Bihar mein bhi Jan Dhan penetration achhi hai, especially SHG (Self Help Group) model ke saath.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir SHG kya hota hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: SHG members regular savings aur internal lending kar sakte hain; bank linkage eligibility/repayment/group quality par depend karta hai. JEEViKA Bihar ka World Bank-supported livelihood/SHG programme hai, lekin har SHG ko automatic bank loan nahi milta.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab women groups apna bank jaisa system chalati hain!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: UPI instant retail payments ke liye NPCI system hai; NEFT, RTGS aur IMPS ke alag settlement/availability features hain. 'World's most successful' ki jagah transaction scale/adoption ko current NPCI/RBI data se evaluate karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir NEFT aur RTGS mein kya difference hai?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: NEFT 24x7 half-hourly batches mein settle hota hai; RTGS real-time gross settlement hai aur ₹2 lakh minimum transaction amount ke saath available hai (no RBI maximum, bank/customer limits ho sakte hain). UPI instant retail payments ke liye convenient hai, par product/risk context alag hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Haan Sir, meine bhi shop mein QR code dekha hai!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Payments Banks specialised banks hain: deposits (current regulatory limit ₹2 lakh per customer, subject to RBI updates), payments/remittances aur limited services de sakte hain, loans nahi. Licence/status aur limit ko latest RBI circular se verify karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab yeh proper bank nahi hain?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Payment Bank full-service commercial bank nahi hota; financial inclusion/payments niche ke liye licensed entity hai. Small Finance Banks deposits ke saath lending bhi kar sakte hain, RBI conditions ke subject.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Achhaaaa... different types banking needs ke liye different banks!

quiz_payload.question: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY) kab launch hui thi?
quiz_payload.explanation: PMJDY 28 August 2014 ko launch hui thi PM Narendra Modi ke tenure mein. Yeh financial inclusion ka flagship program hai. Launch date SSC aur Railway exams mein frequently puchha jaata hai!

quiz_payload.question: Payment Banks mein per customer maximum kitni deposit limit hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Payment Banks mein per customer MAXIMUM ₹2 LAKH (₹2,00,000) deposit kar sakte hain. Yeh RBI guideline hai. Isse zyada deposit regular commercial banks mein hi possible hai. UPSC Prelims ka favorite numerical question!

quiz_payload.question: UPI ka full form kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: UPI = UNIFIED PAYMENTS INTERFACE. Yeh NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India) ka product hai jo 2016 mein launch hua. Full form confusion trap hai exams mein - Universal nahi, UNIFIED!

milestone_payload.title: 🌟 Financial Inclusion Pro!
milestone_payload.motivational_quote: Superb! Ab recent banking initiatives aur current affairs!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: PMMY micro-enterprises ko collateral-free institutional credit categories deta hai; Tarun Plus ne eligible repeat borrowers ke liye limit ₹20 lakh tak expand ki. Stand-Up India SC/ST aur women entrepreneurs ke greenfield enterprises ko ₹10 lakh–₹1 crore range mein support karta hai; current eligibility/notification check karo.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir Mudra Yojana mein teen categories hain kya?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Haan! Shishu (₹50,000 tak), Kishore (₹50,000 se ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh se ₹10 lakh) aur eligible previous Tarun borrowers ke liye Tarun Plus (₹10 lakh se ₹20 lakh) categories ko alag rakho. Limits/scheme rules ko current notification ke saath verify karna chahiye. ⭐ BPSC mains mein impact aur challenges pooche ja sakte hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir aur koi recent scheme?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: COVID-19 ke time PM Modi ne Atmanirbhar Bharat Package announce kiya - ₹20 lakh crore! Banking part mein: Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) - MSMEs ko collateral-free loans, Subordinate Debt Scheme - stressed MSMEs ko support, aur PSBs mein ₹20,000 crore capital infusion.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Ye to bahut bada package tha!

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: Atmanirbhar package mein guarantees, liquidity aur capital-support measures ka mix tha; headline package size ko direct fiscal spending ke equal na samjho. ECLGS uptake, guarantee risk aur repayment outcomes alag evaluate karne hote hain.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir RBI Governor kaun hain current mein?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: As of October 2026, RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra hain; December 2024 mein unhone Shaktikanta Das ko succeed kiya. Governor ko Central Government appoint karti hai; usual appointment 3 years hoti hai, lekin RBI Act framework mein term up to 5 years specify/reappoint ho sakti hai. First Governor Sir Osborne Smith; first Indian Governor C.D. Deshmukh (1943).

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Sir tenure 3 saal hi kyun?

messages.speaker: aman
messages.text: 3 saal usual appointment term hai, lekin ise rigid statutory 3-year rule na samjho — Central Government term specify karti hai, jo RBI Act ke framework mein up to 5 years ho sakti hai. Tenure aur institutional autonomy alag concepts hain. Kabhi-kabhi government aur RBI ke beech disagreements hote hain - jaise demonetization (2016) ke time, ya NPAs handling pe. Yeh 'central bank autonomy' ka issue hai.

messages.speaker: raju
messages.text: Matlab RBI independent hai par puri tarah bhi nahi!

quiz_payload.question: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana mein 'Kishore' category ki loan limit kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Mudra Yojana categories: Shishu (up to ₹50,000), KISHORE (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh). Yeh exact limits SSC aur Railway mein puchhe jaate hain!

quiz_payload.question: RBI Governor ki usual appointment term aur legal maximum ko kaise samjha jata hai?

options.text: Usually 3 years; RBI Act framework mein term up to 5 years ho sakti hai
Governor ka koi appointment term nahi hota

revision_points.point: Established 1 Apr 1935; nationalised 1949; HQ Mumbai. Governor term is government-specified (usual 3 years, up to 5 under RBI Act framework). As of Oct 2026: Sanjay Malhotra. First Governor Osborne Smith; first Indian C.D. Deshmukh. ₹1 note is Government of India; RBI issues other banknotes under law.
Types: Commercial (PSBs-12 after mergers, Private), RRBs (1975, Central 50%, State 15%, Sponsor 35%), Co-operative (3-tier). Nationalization: 1969 (14 banks), 1980 (6 banks).

Repo = RBI liquidity to banks; SDF/reverse repo = liquidity absorption; CRR = cash with RBI; SLR = liquid assets with bank; MSF = marginal overnight facility. Rates/percentages change with RBI policy; do not rote a static corridor.
LPG Reforms (1991). NPA: 90-day default rule. IBC (2016). Bad Bank: NARCL. SARFAESI Act (2002). PSB mergers: 27→12. Payment Banks: ₹2L limit, no loans.

PMJDY (2014): zero-balance possibility, RuPay/DBT/eligible overdraft and insurance benefits subject to scheme rules; exact account count current-dashboard dependent. UPI (2016); Mudra Shishu/Kishore/Tarun/Tarun Plus; Stand-Up India; Payments Banks cannot lend.

Bihar Gramin Bank = unified PNB-sponsored RRB from 1 May 2025 (earlier DBGB/UBGB structure). JEEViKA = World Bank-supported SHG/livelihood programme. Bihar CDR has been below national average; quote year/source and avoid automatic capital-flight conclusion.

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following statements about RBI:

1. RBI was established in 1935 and nationalized in 1949.
2. RBI issues all currency notes including ₹1 note.
3. The tenure of RBI Governor is 3 years.
4. C.D. Deshmukh was the first Governor of RBI.

Which of the above statements are correct?
quiz_payload.explanation:
Statement Analysis:
1. CORRECT - RBI established 1935, nationalized 1949.
2. WRONG - ₹1 note Finance Ministry issue karti hai, RBI nahi!
3. CORRECT - Governor tenure 3 years.
4. WRONG - First Governor Sir Osborne Smith (British). C.D. Deshmukh first INDIAN Governor the.

Answer: 1 and 3 only (Option A). Classic UPSC multi-statement trap!

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following statements about Regional Rural Banks (RRBs):

1. RRBs were established in 1975.
2. Central Government holds 50% ownership in RRBs.
3. RRBs can operate only in rural areas.
4. The first RRB was Prathama Bank in Bihar.

Which statements are correct?
quiz_payload.explanation:
Analysis:
1. CORRECT - RRBs established 1975.
2. CORRECT - Central Govt 50%, State 15%, Sponsor Bank 35%.
3. WRONG - RRBs operate in rural AND semi-urban areas.
4. WRONG - First RRB was Prathama Bank in UTTAR PRADESH, not Bihar!

Answer: 1 and 2 only (Option A). Statement 4 is state-specific trap!

quiz_payload.question:
Assertion (A): Banks are required to maintain CRR with RBI.

Reason (R): CRR helps RBI control money supply in the economy.

Choose the correct option:

options.text: Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true

quiz_payload.explanation: A aur R dono sahi hain; CRR bank deposits ka prescribed cash RBI ke paas lock karta hai, jisse lendable liquidity aur money multiplier par RBI influence kar sakta hai. Exact transmission simple one-to-one nahi hota, par R A ko explain karta hai.

⭐ Consider the following about Bihar's banking:

1. Bihar Gramin Bank is the RRB of Bihar.
2. JEEViKA is supported by World Bank.
3. Bihar's Credit-Deposit Ratio is higher than national average.
4. Bihar has no Public Sector Banks.

Which are correct?
quiz_payload.explanation:
⭐ BPSC TRE Analysis:
1. CORRECT - Bihar Gramin Bank hai (1 May 2025 se PNB-sponsored unified RRB).
2. CORRECT - JEEViKA World Bank supported SHG program.
3. WRONG - Bihar ka CDR LOWER than national (40% vs 75%)!
4. WRONG - SBI, PNB, etc. sabhi PSBs Bihar mein operate karte hain!

Answer: 1 and 2 only (A). State-specific facts critical!

quiz_payload.question:
Consider the following about NPAs and Banking Reforms:

1. A standard term loan is generally classified as NPA after 90 days of overdue status, subject to RBI rules.
2. IBC (Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code) was enacted in 2016.
3. NARCL is an asset-reconstruction vehicle created for stressed-asset resolution.
4. SARFAESI means a secured creditor can always auction any property without notice or borrower remedy.

How many statements are correct?
quiz_payload.explanation: Statements 1, 2 and 3 are correct. Statement 4 is false because SARFAESI has statutory procedure, notice/possession requirements, exclusions and borrower remedies; it is not an unlimited power to auction any property without safeguards. Answer: only three (B).

quiz_payload.question: Payment Banks ki kaunsi characteristic GALAT hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Payment Banks CREDIT CARDS ISSUE NAHI KAR SAKTE! Unhe loans aur credit products dene ki permission nahi. Baaki sab sahi - ₹2L deposit limit, no loan facility, remittance allowed. Yeh negative question format UPSC ka favorite!

quiz_payload.question: Agar Repo Rate 6% hai aur Reverse Repo Rate 5.5% hai, to Repo Spread kya hai?
quiz_payload.explanation: Repo spread = Repo Rate − Reverse Repo Rate = 6% − 5.5% = 0.5%. Ye rate difference hai, RBI ka guaranteed 'profit margin' nahi; actual liquidity operations and financial returns depend on transactions and policy framework.

quiz_payload.question: CRR aur SLR mein kya fundamental difference hai?

options.text: CRR cash hai RBI ke paas, SLR securities mein bank ke paas
CRR pe interest milta hai, SLR pe nahi
CRR zyada hota hai SLR se

quiz_payload.explanation:
FUNDAMENTAL DIFFERENCE:

CRR - CASH form mein RBI ke paas maintain karna (no interest).
SLR - Government SECURITIES/bonds mein invest karna bank ke paas (interest milta hai).

Currently: CRR ~4%, SLR ~18%. Conceptual clarity BPSC/UPSC mein zaroori!
